issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify an interface named 'Rideable', and the template Main.java also refers to 'Rideable'. However, the solution repository introduces an interface named 'Mountable' (and several classes implement 'Mountable') while the solution's Rideable.java is an empty file. This identifier mismatch (Rideable vs Mountable) is likely unintentional and will confuse students about which interface to implement and which name to use in their classes.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the 'Mountable' interface in the solution to 'Rideable' (or have Mountable extend/alias Rideable) and update all classes (Seal, Pig, etc.) to implement Rideable. Also remove or populate the empty Rideable.java in the solution to match the intended design. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to consistently use 'Mountable' instead of 'Rideable' if that name is preferred.
